appearance.title: Make it yours
appearance.text: A name and a look for your server. You can change all of this later in Admin.

admin.title: Your admin account
admin.text: This account manages libraries, settings and who can use the server.
admin.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Longer is better, especially if you'll open Plinthio to the internet.

media.title: What will you keep here?
media.text: These show on your shelf. Everyone picks their own later, too.

manga.title: Manga & Comics
manga.desc: Page-by-page reader, single or double page.

book.title: Books
book.desc: EPUB and PDF reader with progress.

movie.title: Movies
movie.desc: Films with resume, collections and extras.

anime.title: Anime
anime.desc: Series sorted by season and episode.

libraries.title: Add your media folders
libraries.text: Optional. Point Plinthio at the folders your files are in; it scans them straight away. You can add more later in Admin.
libraries.dockerHint: In Docker, your media is under {path}.
libraries.name: Library name
libraries.path: Folder path (on the host or in the container)

household.title: Who else uses it?
household.text: Optional. Each person gets their own progress, bookmarks and look. You can add people any time in Admin.

roles.editor: Editor: can also fix metadata & covers

household.tooShort: Too short: accounts with a password under 8 characters are skipped.
household.partiesText: Watch a movie or show together from different places, in sync, with chat. Friends away from home need a way in (next step). You can change this any time in Admin.

access.title: Where will you use Plinthio?
access.text: Start with what you need now. You can change this any time in Admin → Network.

home.title: At home only
home.text: Phones, tablets and computers on your home network. Nothing is reachable from the internet.

tailscale.title: At home, and away with Tailscale
tailscale.text: For you and people you invite to your Tailscale: private, with nothing opened on your router. Each device needs the free Tailscale app.

internet.title: Also from the internet, for guests
internet.text: Friends and family open a link and sign in, with no apps to install: through Tailscale Funnel (no domain, no router changes) or a web address of your own.

funnel.title: No domain: Tailscale Funnel
funnel.text: A permanent link, no router changes. Best for reading and listening; video may be slower.

domain.title: My own domain
domain.text: Full speed, like media.yourdomain.com. Needs ports opened on your router.

tailscale.title: Set up Tailscale
tailscale.text: Now, or any time after setup: Admin → Network has this same guide, and shows when it's working.

domain.title: After setup: give it a web address
domain.text: The Caddy add-on gives {url} with a real certificate. It needs a domain and ports 80 and 443 forwarded on your router. Step by step, including how to check your internet connection allows it: {docs}. Until then, nothing changes.

access.require2faText: Optional, recommended. Signing in from outside the home network then needs a code from a phone app; at home a password is enough. Anyone without two-factor can still sign in at home and set it up there.

review.title: Review & Launch Plinthio
review.text: Check everything looks right. You can change any of it later.

access.domain: Home and the internet (your own domain)

https.title: Secure connection at home
https.text: The installed app and offline downloads need HTTPS. Plinthio is also at {url} with its own certificate, which each device installs once (Docs → PWA Mobile App Setup). Or use Tailscale for a trusted address with nothing to install.

finished.title: Plinthio is ready
finished.text: One last, optional thing: protect your admin account with two-factor, so a password alone isn't enough.
finished.internet: Worth it, since the server will be reachable from the internet.
finished.later: You can also do this later in Settings → Security.

errors.passwordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.mediaRequired: Please select at least one media type
errors.failed: Setup failed. Please check server connection.
